fields.v: Partly (0.5): main conclusions (low satisfaction, challenges, barriers) follow from the qualitative findings and the exploratory nature is acknowledged, but several reported numbers do not match their own tables (abstract percentages, correlations, counts) and the ANOVA F(1, 11) = 3.46 with p = 0.0004 is implausible
fields.quote: The ANOVA results showed that at least one of the factors differed significantly between students and developers (F (1, 11) = 3.46, p = 0.0004).
fields.why: The Notes list about eleven reporting inconsistencies between text, abstract and tables, including an implausible test statistic, which sits uneasily with a full Yes on whether conclusions follow from the results.
fields.doubt: Nas Notas registaste cerca de onze incoerências entre texto, resumo e tabelas (ex.: ANOVA F(1,11)=3.46 com p=0.0004, pág. 7). Decide se Q9 continua Sim ou passa a Parcialmente.
